items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report $1,600 to $3,800 for a rebuilt unit; CarComplaints lists about $2,300 on average.

items.t: Transmission slips, surges or won't shift
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $2,700 to $3,500.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on the 4.0L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Many shops remove the engine to reach the rear chain. A TrueDelta owner paid $2,200 for tensioners alone.

items.t: Radiator leaks at the plastic tank seams
items.job: Replace radiator and refill coolant
items.note: Owners report about $430 to $1,200.

items.t: Cracked thermostat housing
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and thermostat
items.note: A TrueDelta owner paid $220.

items.t: Wheel bearing or hub failure
items.job: Replace wheel hub and bearing assembly (one wheel)
items.note: Owners report $200 to $810 per hub; rear bearings on 2002 and later independent rear suspension can cost more.

items.t: Worn ball joints
items.job: Replace front ball joints (one side)
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $350 for upper joints and $800 with sway bar parts.

items.t: Clunking from worn sway bar links and bushings
items.job: Replace sway bar end links and bushings
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $120 to $275.

items.t: Cracked liftgate panel below the rear window
items.job: Replace liftgate applique panel and paint
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $550 on average.

items.t: Shifter breaks and won't move out of gear
items.job: Replace steering column (used or new)
items.note: Owners report $366 at an independent shop to about $1,560 typical.

items.t: Door ajar light stays on and dome lights flicker
items.job: Replace door latch with ajar switch (one door)
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $200 typical.

items.t: Plastic intake manifold cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold and gaskets
items.note: A TrueDelta owner paid $1,700 with another repair included.

items.t: Spark plug blows out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with insert and replace coil

items.t: Spark plugs break during removal
items.job: Replace spark plugs with extraction of broken plugs
items.note: If a plug cannot be extracted, a TrueDelta owner paid $2,776 for head work.

items.t: Exhaust manifold leak ticking
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold gasket and studs (one side)
items.note: A TrueDelta owner paid $986 with a belt tensioner.

items.t: Rear differential leaks or fails
items.job: Replace rear axle seals and refill gear oil
items.note: Differential bearing work runs much more; a TrueDelta owner paid $1,200 with hub bearings.

items.t: Heat stuck on hot or clicking behind the dash
items.job: Replace blend door actuator
items.note: If the door itself is broken, the dash may need to come out.

items.t: Blower fan stuck on high
items.job: Replace blower motor control module
items.note: A TrueDelta owner paid $247 at a dealer.

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier and recharge
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $340 for a leak repair and $1,020 for a compressor.

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace one ignition coil and spark plug
items.note: Owners report $300 to $766 when several coils and all plugs are replaced.

items.t: Squeal from the belt tensioner or idler pulley
items.job: Replace belt tensioner and idler pulley
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $175 to $350.

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $128 to $455.

items.t: Power window drops into the door
items.job: Replace window regulator and motor (one door)
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $130 to $305.

items.t: Cruise control switch can start a fire (recall)
items.job: Install fused wiring harness or disconnect speed control deactivation switch
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Firestone tire tread can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace affected tires
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Throttle may stick or not return to idle (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace speed control cable or accelerator parts
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Front brake line can leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front brake line
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Hood can fly up if not latched (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace secondary hood latch
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper control module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Fuel line can leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel line
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Sway bar link can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace sway bar links
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Liftgate glass bracket can break the glass (recall)
items.job: Replace liftgate glass brackets
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Transmission cooler line bolt can loosen (recall)
items.job: Retighten or replace transmission cooler line bolt
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Front seatback recliner may not hold (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat recliner mechanism
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.
